axes.coverage: breadth of relevant records for Toscanini's problem->mechanism->prior-art->candidate->spec->validation->transfer chain (1=narrow, 5=decisive breadth)
axes.authority: evidentiary authority of the issuing organization (1=anonymous, 5=primary legal/national authority)
axes.machine_accessibility: API quality, structure, reliability for programmatic use (1=scrape-only, 5=first-class free API)
axes.licensing: freedom to retrieve, store, and reason over records (1=prohibited, 5=open/CC0)
axes.invention_value: marginal value to invention reasoning beyond existing LIVE sources (1=redundant, 5=uniquely enables a blind-spot class)

tiers.T0_KEEP_RESTORE: already LIVE, or built+blocked with a known unblock - keep/restore first (cheapest coverage win)
tiers.T1_ADD_NOW: absent today, free/open API, fills a blind-spot class - add next
tiers.T2_CEO_DECISION: paid/credential/licensed - value is real but requires a CEO procurement or credential decision

evidence_basis.note: Every status below is MEASURED (Art. XXI), never doc-claimed. Statuses as of 2026-08-30.

europepmc.status: LIVE (re-probed 2026-08-30; UNAVAILABLE in 8/29 report was transient probe failure)
europepmc.note: Most-used source (38% of custody log). Full-text-capable REST, CC0 metadata.

pubmed.note: Overlaps europepmc substantially (same underlying corpus); keep as independence check.

crossref.note: DOI authority; metadata backbone for dedup keys.

elsevier_scopus.note: Abstracts limited without subscription; used within free quota.

lens_scholarly.note: Scholarly-patent linkage - the unique cross-class bridge.

lens_patent.note: Patent+scholarly graph in one system; bibliographic (claims NOT in search results - measured).

google_patents.note: Broad coverage incl. full claims text via XHR; primary patent workhorse with Lens.

patentbear.note: ONLY live claims-text source; metered - every call must earn its quota.

fda_maude.note: NOT ground truth - Art. XXI.5 limitations metadata on every record (incidence UNKNOWN, causation UNVERIFIED); already constitutionally codified.

fda_recall.note: Root-cause narratives - the richest structured failure-evidence source in the fabric.

fda_pma_supplements.note: Manufacturing/processing change records - directly feeds the R375 depth bottleneck (manufacturing_reasoning).

gudid_commercial.note: Commercial reality - what actually survived contact with the market.

gudid_sterilization.note: Sterilization method field - manufacturing constraint evidence.

clinicaltrials_gov.note: What was attempted in humans and what failed - endpoints + interventions.

manufacturing_literature.note: Curated manufacturing-knowledge base - directly feeds manufacturing_reasoning depth.

fda_recognized_standards.note: Which standards FDA accepts - the standards-class anchor without paywalled full text.

ecfr_title21.note: US medical-device regulation as code - requirement extraction.

pubchem.note: Chemical identity + properties; PUG REST is first-class.

cod_optimade.note: Open crystallography via OPTIMADE - materials structural truth.

wipo_patentscope.tier: T3_DEFER (PCT coverage overlaps Lens/Google Patents; scrape-only access)
wipo_patentscope.note: Registered pending a compliant access path.

iso_catalogue.tier: T2_CEO_DECISION (CEO priority #13; catalogue metadata free, full text paid)
iso_catalogue.note: Standard REQUIREMENTS text needs licensed access - a CEO procurement decision, not a coding task.

verdict.why: General-purpose requires reasoning across all six classes. Today: non-medical failure evidence = ZERO sources; standards full-text = ZERO; government technical reports = ZERO custody sources; patents lack claims-text breadth (single metered source); EU commercial reality = ZERO. The medical vertical is world-class (28 LIVE custody sources); the horizontal is not yet.
verdict.cheapest_path: 12 free/zero-code-to-low-code actions take the fabric from medical-world-class to genuinely general-purpose: 2 restorations (openalex budget, europepmc already back), 7 free connectors (ntrs, osti, arxiv, nhtsa, ntsb, eudamed, denovo), 2 free credential registrations (uspto_odp, epo_ops), 1 licensing decision (ISO/ASTM).
verdict.what_is_already_strong: The custody architecture (retrieval log, per-record limitations, measured health, role-coverage matrix, constitutional anti-contamination rules) is the hard part and it EXISTS - Toscanini's expansion is plugging sources into a proven epistemic spine, not building one.
